articles.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.description: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: 'MAKE DEALS': Trump says data centers should pay communities a 'dividend' to win support
articles.description: Trump says data centers should consider community "dividends" as AI financing worries grow.

articles.title: SpaceX up 10% in premarket after earnings beat and Musk hints at Tesla tie-up
articles.description: SpaceX shares jumped after the company reported surging revenue growth in its third quarter, and owner Elon Musk floated a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger.

articles.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
articles.description: The Series A round, which included participation from North Island Ventures and existing investors, brings New York-based Mural's total funding to $28 million.

articles.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
articles.description: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.

articles.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
articles.description: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.

articles.title: Oil prices climb as traders assess Middle East developments
articles.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said Tuesday that naval mines had prevented three tankers attempting to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
articles.description: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.

articles.title: OpenAI's most powerful AI models disabled their own safety monitoring — and one lied about it
articles.description: Warnings about the risks of developing increasingly advanced AI systems have ramped up in recent months, amid cyberattacks from rogue AI models.

articles.title: AI's spending boom faces a 'gut check': Who can actually make money?
articles.description: The AI boom is entering a more unforgiving phase, as investors question whether the billions poured into data centers will translate into sustainable profits.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
articles.description: The platform tracks tokenized securities ownership and transfers, linking to Malaysia’s RENTAS+ system to settle corresponding payments in central bank money.

articles.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
articles.description: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

articles.title: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
articles.description: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.

articles.title: U.S. eyes refining muscle of Indian billionaire Ambani's Reliance as Rubio visits Jamnagar plant
articles.description: Rubio said the "extraordinary" refining capacity of Reliance could help India diversify its energy supplies, hinting at greater offtake of Venezuelan crude.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
articles.description: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

articles.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
articles.description: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
articles.description: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

articles.title: Australian data center operator NextDC's shares plunge 40% after it slashes earnings forecast
articles.description: The company cited power supply delays at its Melbourne facility amid local community and stakeholder opposition for lowering earnings forecast.

articles.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
articles.description: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.
